family_policy: frozen prior proposed family mapping; no rescoring during consolidation
human_gate: Registered independent expert judgments, adjudication and held-out acceptance are required

verbal_bands.1-2: Uninterpretable or severe unresolved scientific defects
verbal_bands.3-4: Material omissions or weak scientific warrant
verbal_bands.5-6: Coherent incremental proposal with bounded limitations
verbal_bands.7-8: Strong, grounded scientific opportunity with a discriminating test
verbal_bands.9-10: Exceptional scientifically consequential opportunity; proposal-stage evidence sufficient

score_meaning: Scientific proposal merit conditional on supplied evidence, not truth or verified novelty

clinical.importance: Clinical consequence of resolving the question, not model size, positive outcome or deployment readiness. Dataset-only feasibility can be useful without a high impact rating.
clinical.novelty: Distinct inference relative to supplied closest studies; changes to safeguards, wording or file packaging are not novelty. External novelty stays unverified.
clinical.grounding: Count direct, traceable evidence only to its supported claim. Literature supports motivation; audits support feasibility; neither supports an untested effect.
clinical.falsifiability: Require identifiable contrast, meaningful threshold, independent units/time boundaries and supportive/adverse/inconclusive rules. Deterministic redundant contrasts are defects.
clinical.data_resolvability: Assess whether configured data measure target constructs, time origin and follow-up; missing recurrence adjudication or unknown censoring dates can block the claim despite abundant rows.
clinical.feasibility: Assess actual joint eligible support and recoverable artifacts, not marginal column availability or code existence.
clinical.alternatives: Require controls that distinguish severity/treatment, measurement and ascertainment rivals; naming many rivals alone is insufficient.
clinical.actionability: Concrete next scientific decision and required evidence; no requirement for immediate clinical use.

battery.importance: 1–2 no material uncertainty; 3–4 archive-specific narrow consequence; 5–6 useful diagnostic/inference question; 7–8 consequential measurement or transferable scientific decision with credible route; 9–10 exceptional domain consequence requiring explicit warrant. Do not award completed-execution points here.
battery.novelty: Score only the incremental question relative to supplied prior work. Routine split correction can improve validity without large novelty. No retrieval match is not evidence of global novelty.
battery.grounding: Separate directly measured capacity/EIS from derived impedance indices and fitted DMA labels. Contradictory data provenance is unknown until resolved, not a zero scientific score.
battery.falsifiability: A discriminating rival, matched information boundary and adverse/inconclusive interpretation earn credit. Many thresholds and controls alone do not.
battery.data_resolvability: Count independent physical specimens and condition groups; assess meaningful temporal/measurement semantics. Repeated cycles/frequencies are not new specimens.
battery.feasibility: Judge the proposed experiment at its stage. Archive parsing and rank checks establish feasibility only; computational expense or model simplicity is not scientific merit.
battery.alternatives: Compare explanations/representations that alter interpretation: measurement state, fixture identity, acquisition clock, continuous versus discrete state, fitted versus physical modes.
battery.actionability: Specify what observation would change a scientific or measurement decision; operational claims need acquisition cost/utility and intervention evidence.

clinical.weights: Retain frozen trial weights for comparability; this review does not validate weights
clinical.discovery: Separate observed evidence maturity, scientific status, consequence and independent confirmation. Do not make feasibility audits equivalent to confirmed findings. Freeze dedup before grading.
clinical.trajectory: Freeze opportunity map; do not reward depth or lengthy safeguards; preserve null for unaudited budget
clinical.calibration: Use paired same-packet disagreement as AI sensitivity analysis. A second AI role is not human reference truth, and score changes are not demonstrated calibration improvement.

frontier: Campaign diagnostic derived from fixed hypothesis scores; never a sixth evaluation level
discovery_policy: Report family ledger, maturity, consequence and uncertainty; old narrow 6/0 gate is secondary, not discovery truth
release_claim: Implementation and internal pilot release; no claim of completed human calibration, system superiority or verified discoveries
hypothesis_population_policy: All 519 reviewed; mean Q uses known eligible generated candidates, excluding imported seeds. Unknown composites stay null.
frontier_policy: F1 includes scoreable imported-seed baselines. F3 uses distinct frozen generated-contribution families only. Unknown Q remains unobserved; raw scores are not monotonically adjusted.
trajectory_progress_policy: Legacy complete full-scope endpoint reviews are separate from 40 fixed-scope prefix reviews: first one edge plus 25/50/75/100% depth of one structurally longest path per dataset. Adjacent delta requires complete matching applicability.
calibration_evidence_scope: Hypothesis development diagnostics against fresh-context AI references, plus enforced path-applicability consistency. Not validated calibration of all five levels.
